strategies.S4GM: S4G (S4 list + quality gate) with size 1.0 SOL when the market cap right after the dev's bundle is >= 36 SOL, else 0.5 SOL
strategies.S4GSM: S4G with size 1.0 SOL when (deployer's own history >= 3 fills averaging >= +0.02) OR (market cap after the bundle >= 36 SOL), else 0.5
strategies.S4G_BIG_ONLY: S4G but only launches with market cap after the bundle >= 36 SOL, at 1.0 SOL (engine-friendly: one fixed size)
strategies.S4G_1SOL: S4G (S4 list + quality gate) with every buy at 1.0 SOL (engine-friendly: one fixed size, --spend-lamports 1000000000)

chosen_on: R1 old run + R2 replay window (both improved); learned from dKMjeGJ4's sizing (bigger size when the dev/bundle is bigger)
